escalations.title: Handlebars.js JavaScript Injection (8 CVEs, CVSS 9.8)
escalations.summary: Handlebars transitive dependency (v4.0.0-4.7.8) allows RCE via AST type confusion if any template strings are user-controlled.

escalations.title: Vitest UI Server Arbitrary File Read & Execution (Source/Frontend, CVSS 9.8)
escalations.summary: Vitest@2.0.5 UI server opens unauthenticated HTTP on localhost:51204. Any network peer can read any file or execute arbitrary code via the test runner.

escalations.title: Vitest UI Server Arbitrary File Read & Execution (portal/Frontend, CVSS 9.8)
escalations.summary: Same vulnerability as DEP-002 affecting portal/Frontend workspace.

escalations.title: Vite Path Traversal + Windows Bypass (CVSS 7.5) [P2]
escalations.summary: Vite dev server exposes .env and other sensitive files via /@fs/.. path traversal. NTLMv2 hash disclosure on Windows UNC paths.

p1_findings.title: Traceability enforcer produces false-green quality gate
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: Runs python3 tools/traceability-enforcer.py on any CI push → prints TRACEABILITY PASSED while 32 of 45 active FRs go unchecked. Missing FR-dependency-seed goes undetected.
p1_findings.impact: The primary quality gate is structurally a false positive. The project believes compliance is at 100% when actual coverage is ~29%.
p1_findings.recommendation: Change enforcer to scan ALL requirements.md files in Plans/ or add explicit active_plans list to inspector.config.yml.

p1_findings.title: Handlebars.js JavaScript Injection (8 CVEs, CVSS 9.8)
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: Attacker crafts a Handlebars template with @partial-block or prototype pollution payload → arbitrary code executes in template rendering context → full Node.js process compromise.
p1_findings.impact: Remote code execution if any Handlebars template string originates from user input.
p1_findings.recommendation: cd Source/Backend && npm update handlebars@4.7.9 --save && npm test

p1_findings.title: Vitest UI Server Arbitrary File Read & Execution (Source/Frontend)
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: Developer runs npm run test:watch → Vitest UI opens on localhost:51204 with NO auth. Same-network attacker fetches /?file=../../../../.env → full secret theft and code execution.
p1_findings.impact: Complete developer machine compromise including .env credentials, SSH keys, and git history.
p1_findings.recommendation: cd Source/Frontend && npm update vitest@3.2.6 --save-dev && npm test

p1_findings.title: Vitest UI Server Arbitrary File Read & Execution (portal/Frontend)
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: Identical to DEP-002 — affects portal/Frontend workspace.
p1_findings.recommendation: cd portal/Frontend && npm update vitest@3.2.6 --save-dev && npm test

p1_findings.title: Portal Backend OpenTelemetry + gRPC Cascade Crashes
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: Attacker sends malformed gRPC message or HTTP payload to portal backend metrics endpoint → @grpc/grpc-js crash handler terminates the process → portal down until orchestrator restarts.
p1_findings.impact: Denial of service on portal/Backend. Trace pipeline goes dark during crash window.
p1_findings.recommendation: cd portal/Backend && npm update @opentelemetry/auto-instrumentations-node@latest --save && npm update @grpc/grpc-js@1.14.4 --save && npm test

p2_findings.title: portal/ application completely outside inspector scope
p2_findings.summary: portal/ implements FR-001–FR-095 (95+ FRs) but is absent from inspector.config.yml source.dirs, traceability enforcer, and all quality gates.
p2_findings.recommendation: Add portal/ to inspector.config.yml source.dirs and source.test_dirs; update CLAUDE.md portal/ description.

p2_findings.title: FR-dependency-seed missing from Source/Backend
p2_findings.summary: No seed.ts exists. 8 known dependency relationships are unseeded; cascade behavior untestable in fresh environments.
p2_findings.recommendation: Create Source/Backend/src/store/seed.ts with idempotent dependency data; call on server startup.

p2_findings.title: Dependency features duplicated across Source/ and portal/ with incompatible FR ID schemes
p2_findings.summary: Two independent dependency tracking implementations with incompatible ID namespaces. Bug fixed in one won't appear in the other.
p2_findings.recommendation: Architectural decision needed: document if intentional, or remove from Source/ if scope creep.

p2_findings.title: form-data CRLF Injection (CVSS 7.3)
p2_findings.recommendation: npm audit fix in Source/Backend and Source/Frontend

p2_findings.title: ws Memory Exhaustion & Uninitialized Memory Disclosure (CVSS 7.5)

p3_findings.title: Plans/dependency-linking implementation delta is materially wrong
p3_findings.summary: Plan marks two test files as missing (they exist) and uses portal/ paths for Source/ code. Teams reading this plan will act on incorrect information.

p3_findings.title: Logger never pretty-prints in development; LOG_LEVEL ignored
p3_findings.summary: Always emits JSON; violates FR-WF-013 acceptance criteria and CLAUDE.md architecture rule.

p3_findings.title: Route handlers call store directly, bypassing service layer
p3_findings.summary: workItems.ts calls store.* directly from 4 route handlers. Architecture rule: 'No direct DB calls from route handlers.'

p3_findings.title: @babel/core Arbitrary File Read via sourceMappingURL
p3_findings.recommendation: npm audit fix in all workspaces

p3_findings.title: body-parser DoS via invalid limit value
p3_findings.recommendation: Verify express middleware uses valid size string for bodyParser.json({ limit: '10mb' })

p3_findings.title: Express version gaps across workspaces (P3)
p3_findings.recommendation: npm update express@4.22.2 --save in Backend, orchestrator, portal/Backend

p3_findings.title: React & React Router major version gap (P3)
p3_findings.recommendation: Plan React 18→19 and react-router 6→7 upgrade for Q4 2026

p3_findings.title: Vite & Vitest version gaps (P3)
p3_findings.recommendation: Update vitest to ≥3.2.6 (security) and vite to latest 5.x
